content: Spring Cloud Contract fits Java/Spring-only shops: contracts colocated with the provider's codebase (producer-driven), generates WireMock stubs distributed via Maven, deeply integrated with Spring/JUnit. Pact is consumer-driven and polyglot (contract generated from consumer test, verified against provider) with a central Pact Broker; best for cross-language ecosystems. For an all-Spring-Boot microservices portfolio project, Spring Cloud Contract has lower setup overhead and demonstrates ecosystem-idiomatic knowledge relevant to a Java-only job market.
